summary: Routine maintenance verification: repository packages current; existing integration and desktop discrepancies retained for review.

Ten selected kernel, graphics, system and application packages had zero missing files. All 19 isolated event-runner and notification tests passed using fixtures. Final package inventory and selected configuration hashes matched. Current installation identity matches the previously failed compatibility validation, whose conclusion hash was verified. Timer remains active every 30 minutes with no local maintenance deadline. No graphical, gaming, performance or model-backed acceptance tests performed. File-presence checks are not full cryptographic package verification.
rollback: No functional system change requires rollback; retain private evidence. Existing configuration, session, jobs and recovery resources preserved. No rollback performed.
problem: Existing compatibility service remains failed because required acceptance evidence was rejected or unavailable. Installed XFCE and active LightDM differ from recorded KDE and SDDM preferences; package history dates the transition to the previous day. Both discrepancies were already recorded by prior maintenance.
solution: Preserved failed compatibility state and prior approved baseline. Recorded local proposals for a separate integration development investigation and interactive desktop reconciliation. Did not replay workers or overwrite the current desktop.
reproduction: Read-only current identity and conclusion-hash comparison, structured acceptance-state inspection, package transaction history, desktop package inventory, display-manager state, isolated unit tests and conventional package health checks. No reproducible distribution defect established.
